primary_contract: nwau_py.ar_drg_mapping_registry versioned AR-DRG ICD/ACHI/ACS mapping metadata registry with explicit provenance and licensing boundaries
description: Add versioned AR-DRG mapping registry capability for ICD-10-AM, ACHI, ACS, and AR-DRG table relationships with conservative source and licensing handling.
completion_policy: complete-with-gaps means the repository owns versioned AR-DRG, ICD-10-AM, ACHI, and ACS relationship metadata, pricing-year compatibility validation, local-only licensed asset references, and fail-closed diagnostics; it does not redistribute licensed mapping tables, code lists, grouping logic, or official grouper assets.

implemented: versioned AR-DRG, ICD-10-AM, ACHI, and ACS relationship metadata
fail-closed diagnostics for missing or incompatible version bindings
not_implemented: redistributed AR-DRG mapping or grouping tables
validated public ICD-to-AR-DRG crosswalks without licensed local evidence
support_scope.claim_boundary: Versioned AR-DRG ICD/ACHI/ACS mapping metadata registry with explicit provenance and licensing boundaries.

gap_register.summary: Official licensed ICD-10-AM, ACHI, ACS, AR-DRG mapping, and grouping-table evidence remains local-only or deferred to licensed workflow tracks.
The repository does not redistribute proprietary mapping tables or present a public ICD-to-AR-DRG crosswalk as validated official grouper output.
